summary: A credential-free low-risk staging dashboard validates health, persistence, and container isolation for the factory.
problem: The factory needs a safe product surface for staging, black-box checks, and rollback rehearsal before external credentials are connected.
outcome: A localhost-only dashboard runs as a hardened non-root container and reports live, ready, database, and risk status.

personas.description: Factory operator verifying staging readiness without customer data or credentials.

critical_journeys.trigger: Operator opens the local pilot URL.
critical_journeys.success: The dashboard and all health endpoints report PASS with a valid SQLite store.

functional_requirements.text: The service shall expose live, ready, and status endpoints.
The service shall persist startup events in SQLite.

nonfunctional_requirements.text: The host binding shall be localhost-only.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Compose port mapping and curl from the VPS loopback.

nonfunctional_requirements.text: The container shall run as non-root with a read-only filesystem and bounded resources.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Dockerfile and Compose security settings plus container inspection.

acceptance_criteria.when: The operator requests all health endpoints
acceptance_criteria.then: Each endpoint returns HTTP 200 and status PASS

acceptance_criteria.when: The operator reads the status endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: The persisted event count is greater than its pre-restart value

assumptions.text: The pilot remains staging-only until external acceptance is complete.
assumptions.expiry_condition: GitHub, provider, Telegram, and offsite evidence are connected.

findings.text: No external integrations or sensitive data are present in the neutral pilot.
